text: Soccer is already off. The engine only reads the leagues you picked (MLB, WNBA, NFL, NHL, NCAAF, NBA, Boxing, UFC). There's no soccer league in the app's league list at all. The BoltOdds, SX and other feeds only ask for those leagues' sports, and the engine log has no soccer lines. So no API or Novig usage goes to soccer. The only soccer traffic is SX's free all-sports socket, which costs no credits. I've dropped the SX soccer-totals idea from my to-do list, so I won't build it.
